errors.evidence: The value of the solid line in 2010 is approximately 0.34, not 0.33. The value drops to approximately 0.335 in 2011.

errors.text_span: Наблюдават се леки колебания по оста X
errors.evidence: This phrasing, which translates to "slight fluctuations are observed along the X-axis," is confusing. The fluctuations are of the Y-axis value (CV) over the course of the X-axis (years), not along the axis itself.
The value for the dotted line in 2019 is stated as approximately 0.30, but the line on the graph clearly ends below the 0.30 gridline, at approximately 0.29.
